references.citation: Feldgarden M, Brover V, Gonzalez-Escalona N, Frye JG, Haendiges J, Haft DH, et al. AMRFinderPlus and the Reference Gene Catalog facilitate examination of the genomic links among antimicrobial resistance, stress response, and virulence. Sci Rep 2021;11(1):12728.
references.note: The Reference Gene Catalog this snapshot projects to a BLAST-searchable nucleotide FASTA.

caveats: The catalog carries more than resistance: stress-response and virulence genes ride in the same FASTA, so a hit is not automatically an AMR determinant — read the FUNC/H its header carries.
Point mutations are not represented. AMRFinderPlus's mutation panel (gyrA, parC, rpoB, ...) needs an aligner against a reference, which this gene FASTA cannot provide; gapit screens presence only.
Upstream versions matter: the catalog gains and renames records continuously, and this snapshot is dated. `gapit db fetch ncbi` re-downloads the current content when version drift matters.

Identity thresholds differ from AMRFinderPlus's internal ones: gapit applies --minid/--mincov (80/80 by default), which is more permissive than AMRFinderPlus's curated per-family cutoffs, so borderline hits should be confirmed.
